sources.title: K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology
sources.manuscript_status: 2026 author preliminary manuscript; published book AMS Surveys 295
sources.inspection: Pinned PDF text and visual inspection of both pages; fresh web PDF retrieval
sources.finding: The book itself adopts unit-modulus ellipticity. Both unrestricted questions and the no-Anosov remark agree with the report. The source-attribution patch corrects the missed section-level definition.

sources.title: Dynamical convexity and elliptic periodic orbits for Reeb flows
sources.manuscript_status: Final author version, published Mathematische Annalen 369 (2017)
sources.inspection: Pinned PDF theorem text and fresh primary metadata
sources.finding: Inclusive definition agrees. On the standard three-sphere, n=1 and the fiber Robbin-Salamon index is 4, giving thresholds 3 and 4k-1. Antipodal invariance and actual Hessian pinching remain extra hypotheses. The authors explicitly address the relevant transversality foundations.

sources.title: Proof of Hofer-Wysocki-Zehnder’s two or infinity conjecture
sources.inspection: Pinned PDF theorem and ECH sections; fresh primary metadata and web PDF retrieval
sources.finding: Closed connected three-manifold, contact form, torsion c1; no nondegeneracy assumption in the two-or-infinitely-many theorem. ECH chain definitions assume nondegeneracy supplied by the all-hyperbolic reduction. Multiplicity one for hyperbolic orbits, a homogeneous U-sequence, and c_k squared/k tending to twice contact volume support the filtered count.

sources.title: Contact three-manifolds with exactly two simple Reeb orbits
sources.manuscript_status: Author version v4; published Geometry & Topology 27 (2023)
sources.inspection: Pinned PDF theorem text and fresh primary metadata confirming v4 and journal reference
sources.finding: Exactly two simple orbits on a closed contact three-manifold forces nondegeneracy and irrational ellipticity of both. No additional nondegeneracy hypothesis is inserted.

sources.title: Proof of the C2-stability conjecture for geodesic flows of closed surfaces
sources.manuscript_status: Final author version; Duke Mathematical Journal 173 (2024)
sources.inspection: Pinned PDF theorem text and fresh primary metadata
sources.finding: The open dense generic geodesic result is not universal. The Anosov criterion retains both uniform hyperbolicity of the periodic-set closure and Kupka-Smale transversality.

sources.title: Systems of global surfaces of section for dynamically convex Reeb flows on the 3-sphere
sources.manuscript_status: Author manuscript; Journal of Symplectic Geometry 12 (2014)
sources.inspection: Pinned PDF theorem text; fresh primary metadata and version-pinned web PDF retrieval
sources.finding: Dynamical convexity gives a disk-like global section with lower-semicontinuous disk Conley-Zehnder index 3, without genericity. The cited PDF is v5, 6 February 2015. No smooth closed-disk return-map extension with an aperiodic boundary is supplied automatically.

sources.title: Existence of a positive hyperbolic orbit in three-dimensional Reeb flows
sources.manuscript_status: Preprint v1, posted 14 September 2026; not independently proof-audited
sources.inspection: Pinned PDF theorem text; fresh primary metadata and abstract. Versioned abstract/PDF web requests returned cache misses before the unversioned abstract succeeded.
sources.finding: Posted 14 September 2026, v1. The general conclusion is positive-hyperbolic existence when at least three simple orbits exist; the b1=0 special step excludes all-negative-hyperbolic spectra. Neither theorem asserts elliptic existence. The proof is not independently certified by this audit.

byte_verification_scope: All seven supplied PDF byte counts and SHA-256 pins were independently rechecked. Browser-rendered online retrieval is not claimed as a byte-identical second download.
